name: 元の投稿を添える返信一覧シート
prompt:
Create a clean, compact Japanese replies-sheet UI matching the native preview exactly in overall composition and 390x720 proportions. Use the native preview as authority for layout and localized copy. Use the original screenshot crop for the replies-sheet context. Use the prior blue-link sample only to set hyperlink color.

At the top, show the dark bold header 返信 and the muted subtitle 「癒やされそう」そんな何気ない時間について. Below it, render three stacked reply groups in the same repeated pattern. Each group has a mint circular avatar with 山; the muted timestamp 2週間前; a pale mint rounded bubble containing two dark lines, こんにちは。きっと大丈夫です。 and またお話ししましょう。; a small pale-mint reaction pill with a forest-green outline heart and dark count 32; a thin elbow-shaped connector; and the blue hyperlink action さらに11件の返信を見る. Repeat that exact pattern three times, as shown in the native preview.

The three visible さらに11件の返信を見る labels are hyperlinks and must be blue #1976D2 per the user’s explicit direction. Keep 返信 as a dark heading, the subtitle and timestamp gray, comment text dark, reaction count dark, and 送信 green. At the bottom, show the pale mint rounded reply input with gray placeholder 返信を追加 and green 送信 action. These exact strings must be preserved. Do not color the send button or placeholder blue.

Match the native spacing: header at top; first group around y100–250, second around y285–435, third around y465–620; input bar around x16/y660, width358, height44. Each bubble begins near x64 and is about 286x80. Keep a white background, no outer card or shadow. Do not add names, metadata, icons, or text that is not visible in the preview. Output only the component.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
